description: DemaConsulting.CanvasNet.VegaLite renders charts described in the Vega-Lite specification language onto a CanvasNet Surface (VegaLiteDocument.Render): a bounded, deterministic JSON specification reader with file/line/column diagnostics, resource limits, and a sandboxed, offline data model. Specification features that are not supported yet are reported with stable identifiers, never silently skipped.
title: CanvasNet.VegaLite
